summary: This report covers two weeks (Sep 25 to Oct 9) because the Oct 2 run never published. There were 57 messages: 28 from Vale and 29 from ALTR. Vale went almost silent in the first week (5 messages) and came back in the second (23). One problem took up nearly the whole window: her main Instagram, @valebragg, has had no working OnlyFans link since the restriction fix around Sep 23, which is about 16 days. That account is the top of her OF funnel. Vivek promised an update 'By tomorrow' on Sep 27 and it never came. Vale chased it four times: 'Also I need a new link for OF' (Oct 1), 'I don’t have anything on my bio' (Oct 2), 'Still no link' (Oct 5) and '👀' (Oct 8). Mayson promised 'We’ll get you one this week!' (Oct 2). On Oct 5 ALTR told her in writing that three more links had 'instantly came down' and that 'It’s going down on highlights it’s going down everywhere'. On Oct 7 Mayson sent a workaround: a Telegram channel link with the domain pinned inside. Vale posted a screenshot the same night asking 'This is what it says ?', and on Oct 8 Mayson answered 'we’re fixing it!!' and 'I’ll get back to you'. At window close the link is still not confirmed working. Melissa got Mayson's attention within 2 minutes of Vale's '👀'. Other things went right. The leak-removal report arrived on schedule on Oct 2, the second week in a row. The Sep 15-30 invoice was paid about a day after it was sent, and Vale used her payment reply to raise the link problem, so this is not a silent fast payment. Ollie Mckinlay came back after 18 days, but only to say 'Thank you' and 'Will relay this to chatters' when she shared fan-facing details (new tattoos, a photo 'In case he shows up'). Nothing on the backlog moved. Roughly $5,300 of paid fan work has now gone an eighth report with no mention: John's $2,200 custom has been unconfirmed for 48 days, and Ryan's, John's videocall and Tyler's are 125, 161 and 187 days old. The Instagram password she posted in plain text on Sep 23 is still in the chat, unrotated, 16 days later. On Oct 3 Mica asked her for more reels while still owing the hook-test readout from Aug 31 (39 days); Vale did not reply. CHURN WATCH (moderate): her asks have shrunk to a single topic. All four asks this window were about the IG link. Her last request about OnlyFans operations (customs, calls, lives) was Aug 9, 61 days ago.

health.rationale: Up 3 from the last published score (38 on Sep 25) and 1 from the unpublished Oct 2 score (40), so flat. On the plus side: Vale re-engaged in week two (5 → 23 messages) and is still giving the chat team fan context unprompted; Mayson shipped a link workaround with a written safety explanation; the leak report held its weekly cadence; Ollie is back in the chat; the invoice was paid in about a day. On the minus side: her main IG has been without a working OF link for about 16 days and the delivered fix was being 'fixed' at close; Vivek's 'By tomorrow' (Sep 27) and 'Will fix one link' (Oct 5) both went unanswered by him; the ~$5,300 backlog, the written rulebook (58 days) and the hook-test readout (39 days) did not move; the plaintext IG password is still in the chat. CLIENT ASKS: 4 distinct asks in this two-week window ('Link on stories to be safe ?', 'Also I need a new link for OF', 'Should I just put something on a highlight', 'This is what it says ?'), plus 3 chases on the same item. Prior windows: about 5 (two weeks to Sep 11), 1 (Sep 18), 2 (Sep 25). So the volume is steady at about 2 a week and not zero, but every ask since Sep 22 has been about keeping her Instagram alive. She no longer asks about customs, calls, lives, fan notes or payments; the last such ask was Aug 9. CHURN SIGNALS: (1) owner silent 30+ days was present until Oct 4 (65 days since Aug 1) and cleared on Oct 5 with a direct written reply on the link problem; (2) results question answered with a call offer: absent in-window, since no call was offered and the link status was given in writing; (3) long-promised deliverable with no written proof: PRESENT (the Aug 1 IG infrastructure 'plenty of updates starting next week', 69 days; the hook-test readout, 39 days; John's custom confirmation, 48 days; and now the link promised 'By tomorrow' 12 days ago); (4) most ALTR messages are billing: absent (4 of 29). Payment was fast (about 1 day), but it came with an ask attached, which weakens it as a churn tell. Score history: 70, 62, 60, 48, 52 (unpublished), 47, 45, 38, 40 (unpublished), 41.
